hypotheses.rationale: The WebSurfer successfully navigated to the Wikipedia page but failed to extract the specific 'Children' information. The output shows the header/menu (top 29%) but the investigation trace notes the trace cuts off before reaching the infobox or text containing the children's names. Had the agent scrolled down or rendered the full page, it would have seen the conflicting info (3 vs 2 children) mentioned in Step 16, preventing the final decision to ignore Kim Braden based on an empty/unverified search result.
